Facility Operations Manual

Document FM-2024-01 · Revision B

This manual is divided into four sections. Each section starts on a new page because the layout engine honors page-break-before: always.

1. Shift handover

The outgoing shift logs every intervention in the shift book, including unresolved alarms and open work orders. The incoming shift verifies the log within the first thirty minutes.

Handover checklist — lock status, fire panel, loading bay gates, cold storage temperature, shift book signed.

2. Weekly inspection

The weekly inspection covers the hydraulic unit, the compressor room, and the roof drainage. Inspections are recorded in the maintenance system with photographs.

Inspection routing — start at the electrical room, continue through the compressor room, end on the roof.

3. Emergency response

In case of an emergency the operator follows the response matrix on the control room wall and calls the duty number first, then the site security desk. The fire alarm drill runs every quarter.

Emergency numbers — duty engineer: 555-0100, security desk: 555-0199, facility manager: 555-0122.

4. Documentation & forms

All forms are available from the document server under /operations/forms. Paper copies are stored in the archive room, shelf D, binders 14 to 21.

Forms index — FM-101 shift book, FM-102 permit to work, FM-103 incident report, FM-104 maintenance request.
